Title: General availability: Azure Kubernetes Service in South Central US, Korea South, and Korea Central

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available in South Central US, Korea South, and Korea Central. This brings AKS to 22 Azure regions. In the list of regions, you can see where AKS is available and where it's coming next.

AKS offers a fully managed Kubernetes environment on Azure. It enables customers to spend less time managing infrastructure and more time building applications. To learn more, check out the AKS product page and documentation.
